name: Martingale Trade Simulator
summary: A Strategy Tester-only EA that provides a manual trading panel with Buy/Sell buttons and optional Martingale averaging and trailing stop features. When martingale is enabled, it opens additional positions with multiplied lot sizes at fixed pip intervals against the losing direction, then adjusts all positions' TP to the volume-weighted average price plus a profit target. The trailing stop feature moves SL to lock in profits when only one position exists per direction.
summary_zh: 这是一个仅在策略测试器中运行的手动交易模拟EA，提供买入/卖出按钮面板，并可选启用马丁格尔加仓和追踪止损功能。启用马丁格尔后，会在亏损方向按固定点距和倍增手数加仓，并将所有持仓的止盈调整到加权均价加利润目标处。追踪止损功能仅在单方向单持仓时生效。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是经典的马丁格尔加仓法：初始开仓后，若价格朝不利方向移动达到设定点距(StepPips)，则以nextLot倍数增加手数再次开仓，通过拉低（买入）或拉高（卖出）加权平均成本，使所有持仓在均价加TPPlus处即可整体获利平仓。入场条件完全依赖用户手动点击Buy/Sell按钮，EA本身不产生任何自动入场信号。出场条件包括原始止损/止盈、马丁格尔调整后的统一止盈（加权均价±TPPlus），以及可选的追踪止损（仅在单方向单持仓时激活）。仓位管理采用指数递增方式：第N次加仓手数=最小持仓手数×nextLot^N，通过lotAdjust函数规范化到合法手数。资金管理方面仅有CheckMoneyForTrade检查保证金是否充足，缺乏最大持仓数限制、最大总手数限制和回撤保护，马丁格尔的指数增长特性在极端行情下极易导致爆仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA implements a classic Martingale averaging strategy: after an initial manual entry, if price moves against the position by StepPips, it opens an additional position with lot size multiplied by nextLot, thereby shifting the volume-weighted average price closer to current price so that all positions can profitably close at the average price plus TPPlus. Entry conditions are entirely manual—the user clicks Buy or Sell buttons on the tester panel, with no automated signal generation. Exit conditions include the original SL/TP, the martingale-adjusted unified TP (weighted average price ± TPPlus), and an optional trailing stop that only activates when exactly one position exists per direction. Position sizing uses exponential growth: the Nth additional lot equals the smallest position's lot times nextLot^N, normalized by lotAdjust to conform to broker volume constraints. Money management only checks whether free margin suffices for the next trade via CheckMoneyForTrade, lacking any maximum position count, total volume cap, or drawdown protection—making the exponential lot growth extremely dangerous during sustained adverse moves.

parameters.name: TPPlus
parameters.description: 马丁格尔均价止盈附加点数
parameters.description_en: Additional TP points on martingale average price

pros: 提供可视化测试面板，方便在策略测试器中手动模拟交易场景
马丁格尔加仓逻辑考虑了swap和手续费对加权均价的修正，计算相对精细
追踪止损区分了初始止损移动和已盈利止损跟进两种情况，逻辑较完善
lotAdjust函数正确处理了手数步长、最小最大手数规范化
pros_en: Provides a visual tester panel for convenient manual trade simulation in the Strategy Tester
The martingale averaging logic accounts for swap and commission corrections in the weighted average price calculation, which is relatively precise
The trailing stop distinguishes between initial stop-loss movement and profit-locked trailing, with relatively complete logic
The lotAdjust function correctly normalizes lot sizes to broker step, min, and max constraints
cons: 马丁格尔策略本质风险极高，指数增长的手数在连续亏损时极易爆仓，无最大持仓或手数上限保护
追踪止损仅在单方向单持仓时生效，多持仓时完全失效，与马丁格尔多持仓场景矛盾
修改止盈/止损时modifyAllSLTP函数在修改成功一个持仓后立即return，导致其余持仓可能未被修改
魔法数字硬编码为0，无法区分其他EA或手动交易的持仓，容易误操作
仅在策略测试器可视化模式下运行，无法用于实盘或纯优化模式
cons_en: The martingale strategy is inherently high-risk; exponential lot growth during consecutive losses can easily blow the account, with no maximum position or lot cap protection
The trailing stop only activates when exactly one position exists per direction—completely disabled during martingale's multi-position scenarios, creating a logical contradiction
The modifyAllSLTP function returns after the first successful modification, leaving remaining positions potentially unmodified with incorrect TP/SL
Magic number is hardcoded to 0, making it impossible to distinguish this EA's positions from other EAs or manual trades, risking unintended operations
Only runs in Strategy Tester visual mode, cannot be used for live trading or pure optimization runs
improvements: 增加最大持仓数和最大总手数限制，防止马丁格尔无限加仓导致爆仓
修复modifyAllSLTP函数，应遍历修改所有同类持仓后再返回，而非修改一个即返回
使用非零魔法数字以区分本EA持仓，并允许在非可视化测试模式下运行
追踪止损应扩展支持多持仓场景，或至少在多持仓时提供基于总浮盈的整体止损机制
improvements_en: Add maximum position count and total volume caps to prevent unlimited martingale scaling that leads to account blowup
Fix modifyAllSLTP to iterate and modify all positions of the same type before returning, instead of returning after the first successful modification
Use a non-zero magic number to distinguish this EA's positions, and allow operation in non-visual tester modes
Extend trailing stop to support multi-position scenarios, or at minimum provide an equity-based overall stop mechanism when multiple positions are open

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略指数增长手数，无最大持仓数/手数上限，极端行情下必然爆仓
追踪止损在多持仓时完全失效，马丁格尔加仓后无任何动态止损保护
魔法数字为0，可能误操作其他EA或手动持仓
modifyAllSLTP仅修改第一个持仓即返回，导致止盈止损不一致
risk_points_en: Martingale strategy with exponential lot growth and no maximum position/lot cap guarantees account blowup in extreme market conditions
Trailing stop is completely disabled during multi-position martingale scenarios, leaving no dynamic stop protection after averaging orders are placed
Magic number of zero risks unintended modifications to positions from other EAs or manual trades
modifyAllSLTP only modifies the first position then returns, causing inconsistent TP/SL across the position group
